# JSI (vendored)

`jsi.cpp`, the out-of-line part of JSI (`facebook::jsi`), which Hermes' prebuilt framework does not export. The JSI
headers come with Hermes, so this file is taken from the same Hermes release.

- Upstream: https://github.com/facebook/hermes, `API/jsi/jsi/jsi.cpp`
- Tag: `hermes-v250829098.0.17`, commit `3477757eb2475555cf8d8df24bfb1deb0613880d`
- File: `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/facebook/hermes/3477757eb2475555cf8d8df24bfb1deb0613880d/API/jsi/jsi/jsi.cpp`,
  sha256 `cb6274a22abc93ecc970066539815e716d3e47716e8f93a9971cf4eb5918ffc1`
- License: MIT, see `LICENSE`

No local patches. A Hermes update takes this file from the new release's tag.
